items_flat.title_en: Mistral raises €3B Series D at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral完成三星領投30億歐元D輪，投後估值逾210億歐元
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a €3 billion Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, which it called the largest equity round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after launch. Samsung Electronics led, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and existing investor PSG Equity as co-leads; new backers include Advent, BlackRock-managed funds and Luxembourg, while NVIDIA, a16z, ASML and others re-upped. The company said proceeds will expand frontier research, training compute, infrastructure, and its commercial footprint across 20 countries.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral宣布完成30億歐元D輪、投後估值逾210億歐元，自稱歐洲科技史上最大股權融資；三星領投，EQT管理的Scaleup Europe Fund與既有投資人PSG Equity共同領投。新進投資人包括Advent、貝萊德管理資金與盧森堡大公國，NVIDIA、a16z、ASML等續投。公司表示資金將用於前沿研究、訓練算力、基礎設施與20國商業擴張。
items_flat.analysis_en: The round is less a flagship-model launch than a bet that enterprises and governments will pay for control of data, models and compute rather than only peak benchmarks. Whether Mistral can convert sovereign-stack positioning into durable frontier-model parity remains unproven by this financing alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這輪融資更像是押注企業與政府願為資料、模型與算力主權付費，而不只看尖端基準。主權全棧定位能否轉成可持續的前沿模型競爭力，單憑融資尚無法證明。
items_flat.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral今日宣布完成30億歐元D輪融資，投後估值逾210億歐元，為歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas covering all 9 billion possible human SNVs
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，涵蓋人類基因組約90億種單核苷酸變異
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable 1-petabyte catalogue of predicted molecular effects for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome—about 9 billion changes. The resource adds an AlphaGenome Variant Impact score and is available for academic use via a no-code portal, the AlphaGenome API, and a Google Antigravity skill; commercial access is slated for Google Cloud later. It precomputes last year’s AlphaGenome model rather than shipping a new consumer LLM.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，以約1 PB資料預先計算人類基因組所有可能單核苷酸變異（約90億種）的分子效應，並提供AVI影響分數。學術用途可經免寫碼網站、AlphaGenome API與Google Antigravity技能查詢；商用預計稍後上Google Cloud。此為去年AlphaGenome預測器的全基因組查表，而非新消費級模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a science-infrastructure release, not a new consumer model: it turns last year’s AlphaGenome predictor into a genome-wide lookup table. Clinical use is explicitly out of the current academic framing, so diagnostic claims should wait for independent validation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是科學基礎設施發布，不是新消費模型：把去年的AlphaGenome變成全基因組查表。臨床用途不在目前學術授權範圍，診斷主張仍需獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a platform containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants — every single-letter change possible — in the human genome.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日推出AlphaGenome Atlas：涵蓋人類基因組90億種單核苷酸變異——所有可能的單字母改變——之效應預測平台。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.5, Sketch, and GPT-Image-2.5 API models
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.5, saying it improves lighting, textures, reference-subject fidelity and multi-turn edits while cutting generation latency by up to 50% versus Images 2.0. ChatGPT adds Sketch (@Sketch doodles as references), templates, on-image comments and shareable prompts; the model is rolling out to all ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex tiers. Developers get GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (default, faster) and Sunburst (higher-control, slower) in the Images API, with Adobe Firefly among early hosts.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Images 2.5，稱在光線、材質、參考主體保真與多輪編輯上提升，延遲較Images 2.0最多降約50%。ChatGPT新增Sketch（以塗鴉當參考）、模板、圖上註解與可分享提示詞，並向所有ChatGPT、Work與Codex方案推出。API新增GPT-Image-2.5 Flare（預設、較快）與Sunburst（更精準、較慢），Adobe Firefly為早期接入方之一。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-and-API image-model refresh, not a new text frontier. The 3-billion-images-per-week figure is company-reported; the practical change is cheaper iteration plus prompt-as-artifact sharing, which increases circulation of synthetic images rather than settling provenance debates.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是圖像產品與API更新，不是新的文字前沿模型。每週30億張為公司自報數字；實質變化是更快迭代與「提示詞可轉傳」，會加速合成圖流通，並未解決來源爭議。
items_flat.quote: Images 2.5 produces more natural lighting and richer textures, is better at preserving the subjects in your reference photos, and follows editing instructions more reliably across multiple turns. We’ve also reduced image generation latency by up to 50% compared with Images 2.0.
items_flat.quote_zh: Images 2.5能產生更自然的光線與更豐富的材質，更能保留參考照片中的主體，並在多輪編輯中更可靠地遵循指令。相較Images 2.0，圖像生成延遲最多降低50%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra is fully rolled out in Codex and ChatGPT Work for paid tiers
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI稱GPT-6 Astra已向付費方案在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面開放
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that Astra is fully rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users in Codex and ChatGPT Work, pointing builders to a live demo on GPT-TV. Help-center language still treats general Chat access to Astra-powered GPT-6 Pro as reserved for higher-priced plans, with Plus limited to Work and Codex and Enterprise off by default until admins enable it. The underlying GPT-6 Astra model itself launched earlier in September, not today.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI在X發文稱Astra已向Plus、Pro、Business與Enterprise用戶在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面開放，並指向GPT-TV即時示範。說明中心仍將一般Chat中的Astra驅動GPT-6 Pro留給較高階方案，Plus僅限Work與Codex，Enterprise預設關閉需管理員開啟。GPT-6 Astra本體已於本月初發布，今日是通路擴展。
items_flat.analysis_en: Availability, not a new model: the split between Work/Codex and ordinary Chat is now the live product policy. How much Plus users can actually consume under existing allowances remains a usage-limit question, not a capability announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是可用性更新而非新模型：Work/Codex與一般Chat的分流已成現行產品政策。Plus在既有額度下能用多少，仍是用量問題，不是能力宣告。
items_flat.quote: Astra is fully rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in Codex and ChatGPT Work. Go build!
items_flat.quote_zh: Astra已向Plus、Pro、Business與Enterprise用戶在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面開放。去建造吧！

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI becomes anchor customer for two Firmus AI factories in Malaysia
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI成為Firmus馬來西亞兩座AI工廠的錨點客戶
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia-backed Australian operator Firmus said OpenAI signed a multi-year deal for dedicated compute at two Malaysia AI Factory sites, lifting Firmus’s contracted capacity above 900 MW across Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia. Sites will use Nvidia’s DSX platform and Vera Rubin systems inside Firmus HyperCube modules; five of seven factories are still under development. OpenAI compute VP Sachin Katti said the sites will help serve regional and global demand; contract value was not disclosed.
items_flat.summary_zh: 有NVIDIA支持的澳洲業者Firmus宣布，OpenAI簽署多年約、承租馬來西亞兩座AI工廠的專用算力，使Firmus在澳、新、印尼與馬來西亞的已簽約容量超過900 MW。機房將採用NVIDIA DSX平台與Vera Rubin系統、搭配Firmus HyperCube模組；七座工廠中五座仍在興建。OpenAI算力策略副總裁Sachin Katti表示將服務區域與全球需求；合約金額未公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is capacity procurement, not a model launch. It extends OpenAI’s Asia-Pacific inference and training footprint as Stargate-style projects elsewhere face delays, but power, water and ready-for-service dates for the Malaysian sites remain execution risks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是算力採購而非模型發布。它擴大OpenAI在亞太的訓練／推論足跡，但馬來西亞廠的電力、用水與實際交付時程仍是執行風險。
items_flat.quote: We’re excited to work with Firmus as we expand our global compute capacity. These new data centers in Malaysia will help us serve growing demand for OpenAI’s products across the region and around the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們很高興與Firmus合作以擴張全球算力。這些馬來西亞新資料中心將協助我們服務區域與全球對OpenAI產品不斷成長的需求。

items_flat.title_en: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2.5 diffusion LLM at 1,107 tok/s
items_flat.title_zh: Inception Labs發布擴散式LLM Mercury 2.5，稱達每秒1,107 token
items_flat.summary_en: Inception Labs released Mercury 2.5, calling it its most capable production diffusion LLM and the largest such model it has trained. The company claims a 40% intelligence lift over Mercury 2, 1,107 tokens per second on widely available Nvidia GPUs, a 260K context window, and list pricing of $0.20/$0.75 per million tokens (80% off at launch). It positions quality as comparable to cost-optimized frontier small models such as GPT-5.6 Luna and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
items_flat.summary_zh: Inception Labs發布Mercury 2.5，稱為其最強量產擴散式LLM、亦為該公司訓練過最大的此類模型。官方稱較Mercury 2智能提升約40%，在常見NVIDIA GPU上達每秒1,107 token、260K上下文，標價每百萬token $0.20/$0.75（上市享八折）。品質對標GPT-5.6 Luna、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite等低成本前沿小模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the speed and quality claims hold under independent evals, diffusion LLMs become a sharper alternative for latency-sensitive agents and voice. Those comparisons are the lab’s own; third-party benches were not published with the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若速度與品質主張經獨立評測成立，擴散式LLM對低延遲代理與語音會更有吸引力。目前對標為官方自述，發文未附第三方基準。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re releasing Mercury 2.5, our most capable production model yet. It is a significant step up in quality over Mercury 2, with the same low-latency, low-cost serving profile.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日發布迄今最強的量產模型Mercury 2.5。品質較Mercury 2明顯提升，同時維持低延遲、低成本的服務特性。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches muse.ai personal agent and publishes a safety deep dive
items_flat.title_zh: Meta上線muse.ai個人代理並發布安全深潛文
items_flat.summary_en: Meta AI’s official account said it launched muse.ai as a personal AI agent and published a deep dive on how safety is built into a system that accumulates long-lived user context. The post frames usefulness and privacy risk as the same property: an agent that knows you over time holds more personal data. Independent corroboration of feature scope beyond the X announcement was limited at publication time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta AI官方帳號宣布上線個人代理網站muse.ai，並發布長文說明如何為會累積長期使用者脈絡的系統做安全設計。貼文將「有用」與「隱私風險」視為同一來源：越了解你的代理持有越多個人資料。發稿時除X公告外，功能範圍的獨立核對仍有限。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a consumer-agent surface and safety narrative, not a new open-weight Llama or Muse base model. The unresolved issue is what data the agent retains, under which controls, and how that differs from existing Meta AI in WhatsApp, Instagram and the Meta AI app.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是消費端代理介面與安全論述，不是新的開源權重Llama或Muse基座模型。尚未釐清的是代理留存哪些資料、受何控制，以及與既有Meta AI（WhatsApp、Instagram、App）有何實質差異。
items_flat.quote: Today we launched muse.ai a personal AI agent, and published a deep dive on how we built safety into its system. An agent that gets to know you over time necessarily holds a lot of context about you.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日推出個人AI代理muse.ai，並發布深潛文說明如何把安全做進系統。一個會隨時間認識你的代理，必然持有大量關於你的脈絡。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands journalism support from J-schools to newsrooms
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將新聞支援從新聞學院擴到新聞室
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is launching a multi-faceted journalism initiative starting with CUNY’s Newmark J-School and Northwestern’s Medill School for the 2026–2027 year, including more than 400 ChatGPT Edu subscriptions for interested graduate students and faculty. The post also recaps ongoing work with the American Journalism Project, Lenfest Institute, WAN-IFRA and INMA, plus OpenAI Academy for news organizations. Edu workspace data is not used to train OpenAI models, the company noted.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布啟動多面向新聞計畫，2026–2027學年先與紐約市立大學Newmark新聞學院、西北大學Medill合作，向有意願的研究生與教師提供逾400個ChatGPT Edu席次。文中並回顧與美國新聞計畫、Lenfest研究所、WAN-IFRA、INMA及OpenAI Academy的既有合作。公司註明Edu工作區資料不用於訓練其模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is ecosystem access and training, not a model or API change. It may ease newsroom adoption friction, but it does not resolve ongoing disputes over training data, licensing, or compensation with publishers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是生態系准入與培訓，不是模型或API變更。或可降低新聞室導入摩擦，但並未解決與出版商在訓練資料、授權與補償上的既有爭議。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI is launching a major, multi-faceted initiative to support the journalism ecosystem with tools, training, partnerships, shared learning, and practical enablement for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI正啟動一項多面向計畫，以工具、培訓、夥伴關係、經驗共享與實務賦能，支援學生、教師、記者與新聞機構。

google.title_en: DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas covering all 9 billion possible human SNVs
google.title_zh: DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，涵蓋人類基因組約90億種單核苷酸變異
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable 1-petabyte catalogue of predicted molecular effects for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome—about 9 billion changes. The resource adds an AlphaGenome Variant Impact score and is available for academic use via a no-code portal, the AlphaGenome API, and a Google Antigravity skill; commercial access is slated for Google Cloud later. It precomputes last year’s AlphaGenome model rather than shipping a new consumer LLM.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，以約1 PB資料預先計算人類基因組所有可能單核苷酸變異（約90億種）的分子效應，並提供AVI影響分數。學術用途可經免寫碼網站、AlphaGenome API與Google Antigravity技能查詢；商用預計稍後上Google Cloud。此為去年AlphaGenome預測器的全基因組查表，而非新消費級模型。
google.analysis_en: This is a science-infrastructure release, not a new consumer model: it turns last year’s AlphaGenome predictor into a genome-wide lookup table. Clinical use is explicitly out of the current academic framing, so diagnostic claims should wait for independent validation.
google.analysis_zh: 這是科學基礎設施發布，不是新消費模型：把去年的AlphaGenome變成全基因組查表。臨床用途不在目前學術授權範圍，診斷主張仍需獨立驗證。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a platform containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants — every single-letter change possible — in the human genome.
google.quote_zh: 我們今日推出AlphaGenome Atlas：涵蓋人類基因組90億種單核苷酸變異——所有可能的單字母改變——之效應預測平台。

meta.title_en: Meta launches muse.ai personal agent and publishes a safety deep dive
meta.title_zh: Meta上線muse.ai個人代理並發布安全深潛文
meta.summary_en: Meta AI’s official account said it launched muse.ai as a personal AI agent and published a deep dive on how safety is built into a system that accumulates long-lived user context. The post frames usefulness and privacy risk as the same property: an agent that knows you over time holds more personal data. Independent corroboration of feature scope beyond the X announcement was limited at publication time.
meta.summary_zh: Meta AI官方帳號宣布上線個人代理網站muse.ai，並發布長文說明如何為會累積長期使用者脈絡的系統做安全設計。貼文將「有用」與「隱私風險」視為同一來源：越了解你的代理持有越多個人資料。發稿時除X公告外，功能範圍的獨立核對仍有限。
meta.analysis_en: This is a consumer-agent surface and safety narrative, not a new open-weight Llama or Muse base model. The unresolved issue is what data the agent retains, under which controls, and how that differs from existing Meta AI in WhatsApp, Instagram and the Meta AI app.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是消費端代理介面與安全論述，不是新的開源權重Llama或Muse基座模型。尚未釐清的是代理留存哪些資料、受何控制，以及與既有Meta AI（WhatsApp、Instagram、App）有何實質差異。
meta.quote: Today we launched muse.ai a personal AI agent, and published a deep dive on how we built safety into its system. An agent that gets to know you over time necessarily holds a lot of context about you.
meta.quote_zh: 我們今日推出個人AI代理muse.ai，並發布深潛文說明如何把安全做進系統。一個會隨時間認識你的代理，必然持有大量關於你的脈絡。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral raises €3B Series D at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral完成三星領投30億歐元D輪，投後估值逾210億歐元
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced a €3 billion Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, which it called the largest equity round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after launch. Samsung Electronics led, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and existing investor PSG Equity as co-leads; new backers include Advent, BlackRock-managed funds and Luxembourg, while NVIDIA, a16z, ASML and others re-upped. The company said proceeds will expand frontier research, training compute, infrastructure, and its commercial footprint across 20 countries.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral宣布完成30億歐元D輪、投後估值逾210億歐元，自稱歐洲科技史上最大股權融資；三星領投，EQT管理的Scaleup Europe Fund與既有投資人PSG Equity共同領投。新進投資人包括Advent、貝萊德管理資金與盧森堡大公國，NVIDIA、a16z、ASML等續投。公司表示資金將用於前沿研究、訓練算力、基礎設施與20國商業擴張。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The round is less a flagship-model launch than a bet that enterprises and governments will pay for control of data, models and compute rather than only peak benchmarks. Whether Mistral can convert sovereign-stack positioning into durable frontier-model parity remains unproven by this financing alone.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這輪融資更像是押注企業與政府願為資料、模型與算力主權付費，而不只看尖端基準。主權全棧定位能否轉成可持續的前沿模型競爭力，單憑融資尚無法證明。
frontier_other.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mistral今日宣布完成30億歐元D輪融資，投後估值逾210億歐元，為歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資。

frontier_other.title_en: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2.5 diffusion LLM at 1,107 tok/s
frontier_other.title_zh: Inception Labs發布擴散式LLM Mercury 2.5，稱達每秒1,107 token
frontier_other.summary_en: Inception Labs released Mercury 2.5, calling it its most capable production diffusion LLM and the largest such model it has trained. The company claims a 40% intelligence lift over Mercury 2, 1,107 tokens per second on widely available Nvidia GPUs, a 260K context window, and list pricing of $0.20/$0.75 per million tokens (80% off at launch). It positions quality as comparable to cost-optimized frontier small models such as GPT-5.6 Luna and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Inception Labs發布Mercury 2.5，稱為其最強量產擴散式LLM、亦為該公司訓練過最大的此類模型。官方稱較Mercury 2智能提升約40%，在常見NVIDIA GPU上達每秒1,107 token、260K上下文，標價每百萬token $0.20/$0.75（上市享八折）。品質對標GPT-5.6 Luna、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite等低成本前沿小模型。
frontier_other.analysis_en: If the speed and quality claims hold under independent evals, diffusion LLMs become a sharper alternative for latency-sensitive agents and voice. Those comparisons are the lab’s own; third-party benches were not published with the post.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 若速度與品質主張經獨立評測成立，擴散式LLM對低延遲代理與語音會更有吸引力。目前對標為官方自述，發文未附第三方基準。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re releasing Mercury 2.5, our most capable production model yet. It is a significant step up in quality over Mercury 2, with the same low-latency, low-cost serving profile.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們今日發布迄今最強的量產模型Mercury 2.5。品質較Mercury 2明顯提升，同時維持低延遲、低成本的服務特性。

brief_en: Mistral closed a Samsung-led €3B Series D above €21B. DeepMind shipped AlphaGenome Atlas for 9B SNVs. OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.5, said Astra is live in Codex and ChatGPT Work for paid tiers, and became Firmus’s Malaysia compute anchor. Inception released Mercury 2.5.
brief_zh: Mistral完成三星領投30億歐元D輪、估值逾210億。DeepMind上線涵蓋90億SNV的AlphaGenome Atlas。OpenAI推出Images 2.5、宣布Astra已對付費用戶在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面開放，並成為Firmus馬來西亞算力錨點客戶。Inception發布Mercury 2.5。
